title: chrysothamnus nauseosus subsp. leiospermus
intro: Chrysothamnus nauseosus subsp. leiospermus, commonly known as Leiospermum, is a subspecies of shrub that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is also known as "rubber rabbitbrush" due to its distinctive leaves. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and cough. Leiospermum contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
